points: Parthians, Medes and Elamites: they chose to stay after the Persian captivity was over. Remember Cyrus gave them liberty to go back and build the temple. Some came over to this side of the world, as we get our natives and Hispanics, from Dan; others chose to stay in the land of captivity; then you have those who went back to Jerusalem, that's what you read about, the Galilee of the Gentiles.

Parthians and Medes, that's from the Persian captivity. The Elamites, Mesopotamia, are Babylonians. Cappadocia, Pontus, that's Asia Minor. Egypt, which is northeast Africa, and parts of Libya, which is North Africa; Cyrene is still North Africa; and strangers of Rome, where they spoke Latin.

“Parthians, and Medes”: that’s around Iran. The Israelites that came from Iran with the Holy Spirit on them had to teach and preach in that dialect, not in any form of Hebrew, and when they got to Lord or God it had to be translated in that Iranian language so they knew exactly what was being talked about. “And Elamites”: that’s East India. “And the dwellers in Mesopotamia”: that’s Babylon, Iraq. If you came from East India or Iraq, you heard the gospel in your first tongue, your mother language, not in Hebrew. “And in Judea”: that’s Hebrew. “And Cappadocia”: that’s Turkey.
